text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — prepping X + LinkedIn thread for next week's launch + webinar. Need final social copy (2 variants), hero GIF, 1 carousel asset, and the inbound lead routing plan. Can ops confirm SDR tag/queue? Doc: https://docs.google.com/ripple-launch (work-in-progress)
Maria: On it. I'll drop two copy variants by EOD and a short thread outline. What time windows do we want for X vs LI?
Jun Park: Prefer 9:00am PST for X so it hits US morning, and 11:00am PST for LinkedIn. Also ok with an evening GMT push at 4pm.
Samir: For lead routing — plan to send webinar signups to SFDC campaign "RIPPLE_LAUNCH" and assign to queue "Inbound-Launch". We can auto-tag source via Zapier. Suggest UTM plan:
Samir: ```utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ripple-launch&utm_content=variantA```
Olivia: Hero GIF: design can do a 6s loop. Will confirm assets morning. Legal: is the benchmark claim cleared? Alex flagged '3x lower latency' in the thread.
Maria: I can soften to "~3x lower median latency vs our baseline" and link the benchmark doc. Will add CTA and webinar registration link. 
Alex: Good — include a short benchmark narrative as the thread opener. Something like: "Benchmarking on common production stacks shows ~3x median latency improvement — details + dataset link below." Make sure we have the benchmarking appendix (jun?) for numbers.
Jun Park: I'll paste the appendix numbers into the doc tonight. Also adding a note about test env and model configs.
Samir: Also want to set an engagement follow-up plan: if thread hits >1k likes or >100 signups, trigger a midweek reminder post and an SDR high-touch cascade. Can ops schedule triggers?
Maria: I can add the follow-up copy templates. @ContentBot can you schedule the initial posts and a placeholder follow-up slot?
ContentBot: Scheduled draft created: X @2026-03-10T09:00:00-08:00, LinkedIn @2026-03-10T11:00:00-08:00. Follow-up slot reserved for 2026-03-12. Link: https://app.scheduler/ripple-draft
Olivia: Legal ok with "~3x" phrasing — just keep the supporting benchmark link live. Also please remove customer names from screenshots.
Maria: Quick ask for captions: can design export GIF at 1200x675 for X and 1200x627 for LinkedIn? Will add both variants in drive.
Samir: Updating the Zapier flow: will add field "sdr_queue=Inbound-Launch" and "campaign=RIPPLE_LAUNCH". Also adding conditional: if utm_content==variantB then assign to 'Outbound-B' nurture.
Alex: Perfect. Can everyone review the doc by 5pm PT so we can lock copy and assets? If any blockers, flag here.
Jun Park: Reviewing now. minor tweak to sample copy for the 1st tweet.
Maria: Dropped Variant A + B in doc and the thread outline. Added suggests for emojis and hashtags (#LLMinfra #Inference)
Olivia: Approved final copy except for one line with a comparative claim — updated in doc.
Samir: Ops checklist added: tracking tags, SFDC mapping, Zapier steps, and SDR handoff playbook.
Alex: Thanks team. If we get early engagement, let's queue a short AMA thread with the engineering lead. @Jun Park pls prep 3 talking points.
Jun Park: On it, will add to doc.
Maria: I'll follow up with a quick Slack ping to the SDRs when signups start. :rocket:
ContentBot: Reminder set for 2026-03-10T08:30:00-08:00 to confirm assets live.
Alex: Closing thread — will post final launch plan after 5pm PT. :thumbsup:
